d: I Guys, I have been an Ozaki fan for a long time, and I didn't want to wait any longer for others to translate his stories. Since I don't know any Japanese, I decided to use a translation tool to better understand the text and pick up on certain details. I’m sharing the translation I came up with for *The Extraordinary Life of Widow Announcer Ruriko*. I hope you enjoy it while we wait for others with more expertise to provide a better translation. Happy reading.
n: [Doujinshi] [Ozaki Akira] The Extraordinary Life of Widow Announcer Ruriko
